observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 140.» (L2) and «p. 141.» (L27) in the right margin.
body L11: the second o of «Aegyptiorum» is printed broken; only its right side is visible.
body L14: the e of «ei» is printed broken, like a c.
body L4: the first a of «quartae» is printed broken, like a turned e.
body L10, L11, L15, L24, L28: the o is printed thin, its sides as broken strokes, in «seorsum», «eo», «annorum», «oppositionis» (the second o) and «aequinoctialem».
body L31, L38: the e of «et» in «[et Lunae]» is printed broken, and the s of «locus» like a 3.

body: on the Coptic era of this chapter, Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XX) are recorded with note 4 of p. 92: its years are Egyptian, or vague, years counted from the era of Dhū ’l-qarnayn.
notes_left L2: the opening parenthesis of «(adn. 3)» is printed broken.
notes_right L1: the t of «explicat» is printed broken.
notes_right L3: a speck stands over the o of «non»; it is not an accent.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
